segments.text: Do people still ask about why your camera is green? Yeah all the time
It's no big deal though. I've turned a new leaf recently. I've had a few like
First-hand encounter with retarded people, you know, so I feel like I've it's changed me as a person
and now I'm way more tolerant and
I don't get pissed or nothing, you know
So let me know if you are retarded and you need a cape
